subject: executor: introduce max_user_connections (#59197)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent in scope (executor/parser/privilege/session/sessionctx). No plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness, privilege, session/upgrade, or SQL-semantics issues found.
